name: Dark Magician Knight
source_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "Knight's Title". If this card is Special Summoned successfully, select 1 card on the field and destroy it.
notes: The summoning restriction is rules text; the script covers the on-summon destruction.
